scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:typescript
scripts.test:typescript: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run check:site:static
scripts.check:functional: npm run check:types && npm run test:typescript && npm run check:transcript-store && npm run check:stream-index && npm run check:js && npm run check:site:static && npm run test:legacy
scripts.check:offline: npm run check:functional && git diff --exit-code && git diff --check
scripts.check:js: node --check scripts/Build-SearchIndex.mjs && node --check site/assets/js/search-core.js && node --check site/assets/js/search.js && node --check site/assets/js/site.js
scripts.launch:hugo: npm run build:site-content && hugo server --source site --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 1314 --baseURL http://127.0.0.1:1314/ancient-egypt-and-the-bible/ --appendPort=false --disableFastRender
